_doc: Text and ground pairs that scripts/check-contrast.mjs grades against src/ds/tokens.css. Each group crosses every fg with every bg. A bg written 'A over B' is A composited over B (for translucent tokens like --plate). min is the WCAG ratio; set large: true (min 3) only for text that is 18px+ or 14px+ bold.

groups.what: Text on the white panel and its hover and sunk rows
Labels on the light plate over the farm, on its lightest and darkest grounds
Ink and the matching hue on the sprout wash
Ink and the matching hue on the out wash
Ink and the matching hue on the fail wash
White on the filled sprout button, at rest and on hover
White on the filled out button, at rest and on hover
White on the filled fail button, at rest and on hover
